### gapfill:ops
Corrections and confirmations for the ops domain, all re-read this pass in assembly_valheim_SERVER.decompiled.cs:

1. The catalog's 'Admin command channel' RULED-OUT entry is wrong and the domain note is right, with one precision: a MOD-NAMED command never leaves a vanilla client (Terminal.TryRunCommand :45736-45737 needs the word in its own dictionary), but any vanilla command flagged remoteCommand:true whose IsValid fails client-side is forwarded whole (:45741-45744). Six such non-cheat commands exist (genloc, setkey, removekey, resetworldkeys, setworldpreset, setworldmodifier); `listkeys` is isCheat:true (:43640), not false as one critic wrote. The chat window forwards them too (Chat.InputText :41947-41955 + Chat.isAllowedCommand :41938-41945 only blocks cheat commands), so no -console flag is required to SEND; replies via RemotePrint land in the F5 console buffer, hence the toast mirror.

2. NEW: a vanilla 1.0.7 dedicated server has no stdin reader — zero Console.ReadLine/Console.In hits in any of the four server decompiles. Every brief sentence of the form 'run setkey/listkeys from the dedicated server's stdin console' describes a non-existent channel; those commands have only ever been reachable through RPC_RemoteCommand from an admin client. ZNet.RemoteCommand called on the server NREs (:81873 → :81893 rpc.GetSocket()).

3. Client-originated portal edits never dirty the portal chunk (RPC_ZDOData :77076-77139 → Deserialize :74205-74240 raw Adds → AddIfPortal :77739-77742 early return before :77751). Vanilla is rescued only when a SERVER-local SetConnection follows; the deferred-RPC partner case is not rescued. Also confirmed: ZDO.RemoveString (:74072/:75146) does not bump revision and Serialize writes present keys only, so key removal never propagates — revert with sentinels.

4. ForceSendZDO is gated on peer.ShouldSend (:77273), BUT a freshly added ZDOPeer has an empty m_zdos (:76767-76773) so ShouldSend is true (:76003-76015) — join time is the one guaranteed force-send window; 'touch to resync' elsewhere still needs a revision bump.

5. NoBossPortals: RandEventSystem.GetBossEvent reads EnemyHud (per-client); only the activeBosses key half is world-wide. The four routed registrations at :105284-105287 belong to PersistentEventSystem (RequestStartEvent/StopEvent run server-side with no sender check); RandEventSystem's only routed RPC is SetEvent :106781.

6. EnvMan.FixedUpdate (:95685-95710) has no local-player gate and derives m_smoothDayFraction from ZNet time, so GetDayFraction should advance headless — the probe verifies rather than assumes.

7. Vanilla's own ZNet.GetPublicIP (:79390-79420) uses System.Net.Http.HttpClient on the dedicated server — the strongest available evidence for the outbound networking runtime; inbound HttpListener remains unproven and is now filed as needs-ingame-check with an exact probe.

8. Singleton null-ness (Chat/MessageHud/Minimap/DamageText) remains contradictory in the decompile (Game.Awake instantiates only Console and ServerOptionsGUI :100038-100045; ZNet.LowDiskLeftInformer dereferences MessageHud unguarded :80258) — the CapabilityProbe logs it at boot and the ping-input engine picks Register vs HandleRoutedRPC prefix from the result instead of guessing.

### gapfill:targeted
Zone-generation is the missing substrate under every targeted option: the server (and only the server) generates zones, one per 0.1 s tick, only around peers' reference positions (ZoneSystem.Update :113924-113941, CreateGhostZones :113971-113991, PokeLocalZone Client-mode for non-servers :114028). Everything about 'what a traveller finds at a phantom destination' — vegetation through the frame, ungenerated altars, 15 s fallback landings, ambient spawns on the pad — is decided by whether and when SpawnZone (:114071-114107) ran for that zone, and the mod can drive it directly with publicized private calls. Verified this pass, correcting or sharpening earlier claims: (1) LocationInstance.m_position.y is a WorldGenerator height ONLY for world-gen instances; SpawnLocationMidGame sets y via the dead GetGroundHeight raycast (:115102) and registers placed:false, and PlaceLocations only runs for ungenerated zones (:114086, :114960) — a mid-game registration in a generated zone is never placed. (2) TestSpawnLocation is a booby-trap headless (MessageHud deref :115071, m_didZoneTest → SkipSaving :115072/:115875, s_cheated :115075); use SpawnLocation(Ghost) directly and destroy the returned list. Full mode on the server only adds transient garbage: RemoveObjects (:82196-82226) destroys any instance outside the pinned active area on the next 1/30 s pass and also DestroyZDOs non-persistent owned ZDOs. (3) Vegetation exclusion is purely ClearArea (box test :114340-114350, list filled only by PlaceLocations :114968-114972) plus a raycast IsBlocked (:115496-115500, mask :113423) that cannot see a phantom ZDO — so vegetation WILL be generated through a phantom portal in an ungenerated zone unless a PlaceVegetation prefix injects a ClearArea. (4) m_exitDistance/m_allowAllItems are read from the SOURCE portal (:143546, :143533) — confirmed; prior 'destination portal's m_exitDistance' wording is wrong. (5) ForceSendZDO is still gated on peer.ShouldSend (:77273) — a force-send of an unchanged ZDO sends nothing; 'touch to resync' needs a real revision bump. (6) WearNTear.UpdateWear applies 100 damage per update when !HaveSupport() with m_noSupportWear default true (:149205, :149705-149711): a floating fabricated phantom is demolished by the owning client; place at terrain height. (7) RandEventSystem.GetBossEvent() is EnemyHud.instance.GetActiveBoss().m_bossEvent (:106939-106949) — per-client HUD state; only the activeBosses key half of the TeleportWorld boss gate is world-wide. (8) ZNetScene.IsAreaReady ignores ZDOs whose prefab is invalid (IsPrefabZDOValid false for hash 0, :82077), so a Void Anchor does not stall a traveller's arrival, whereas a LocationProxy in async-load state marks the zone loading (client :103137-103141) and correctly delays arrival until the location exists. (9) The server-only invalid-prefab reaper (:82137-82143) only runs for ZDOs in the server's pinned active area, so anchors elsewhere are safe from it. (10) SectorSubscription-style CreateSyncList postfix can be driven by server policy alone (append the destination sector for any peer near a managed portal) — the 'needs a client request' framing was wrong; combined with pre-generation it lets a vanilla client pre-load the destination zone's ZDOs before transit. Still Inspector-bound and needing one in-game pass each: m_locationProxyPrefab ZNetView flags, which location children are ZNetView vs static, whether SpawnSystem lives on m_zoneCtrlPrefab, the tombstone prefab name, and whether LoadFields overrides of Location.m_noBuild take effect on a stock client.

### gapfill:access
Three findings reshape the access domain. (1) Enforcement is not only 'one ZDO, every peer reconverges': the server chooses what each peer is SENT (ZDOMan.CreateSyncList :77212-77241 + AddForceSendZdos :77263-77286 are the only delivery paths, RouteRPC :83597-83629 forwards RPCs only), so per-peer withholding is a genuine server-enforced per-player gate; it must be paired with a revision-aware ownership pin because ReleaseNearbyZDOS (:76901-76926) hands ownership to peers holding no copy and RPC_ZDOData applies foreign owners through SetOwnerInternal (:77114, :77128), bypassing any ZDO.SetOwner prefix. (2) TeleportWorld's own RPC_SetTag/RPC_SetConnected (:143587-143629) are usable in the server→owner direction as cooperative write primitives, which removes the DataRevision race for every revert on a client-owned portal; the returning ZDOData never dirties the portal chunk (AddIfPortal :77738-77742), so SetDirtyPortals (:76702) is mandatory after any tag-only change, client- or server-originated. (3) Vanilla-honoured global-key gating is weaker than the briefs stated: the GetBossEvent() half of gate 3 is a per-client EnemyHud read (:106939-106950), so only activeBosses is world-wide. Shaky-claim verdicts in this domain: PersistentEventSystem's four registrations at :105284-105287 are NOT RandEventSystem's (whose only routed RPC is SetEvent) and RequestStart/StopEvent run on the server unauthenticated with unchecked indices (:105347, :105386); Ship Forward/Backward/Stop/Rudder handlers have no owner or sender gate (:140538-140580); the SectorSubscription CreateSyncList postfix needs no client request and is the mechanism for destination pre-delivery; AddForceSendZdos is gated on peer.ShouldSend (:77273) so 'ForceSendZDO pushes regardless' is false once a peer's cache is current; the admin RPC_RemoteCommand channel is real for names the client already knows (Terminal.TryRunCommand :45737-45746, RPC_RemoteCommand :81879-81889) and dead for new names. Everything per-player that acts on the traveller rather than their property remains reactive (Arrival Bouncer) except withholding, which is preventive because the vanilla client cannot obtain a ZDO from anywhere but the server.

### gapfill:routing
DELIVERY, NOT ROUTING, IS THE BOTTLENECK. Every routing option in the catalog writes a ZDOID into a portal and assumes the traveller can use it. The decompile says otherwise: a peer only ever receives ZDOs inside FindSectorObjects around its own m_refPos (ZDOMan.CreateSyncList :77212-77240), portals are NEVER in the distant ring (FindDistantObjects reads only m_objectsBySector :77384-77404), the server's own portal-pairing writes go to peers only via the one-shot ForceSendZDO in Game.SetConnection, and a vanilla client's only self-help is the RequestZDO fired from TeleportWorld.TargetFound (:143651-143654) — which UpdatePortal polls only while a *teleportable* player is inside m_activationRange (5 m) because of the `flag2 && TargetFound()` short-circuit at :143507. So the 'silent dead first walk-through' is real but NARROWER than the digest says: it bites when a player crosses the trigger within roughly one 0.5 s poll + RTT + one 0.05 s send cycle of (a) entering the 5 m ring or (b) the server re-pointing the portal. A walking player usually wins the race; a sprinting player, a player already standing in the ring when the server re-points, or a player carrying ore (flag2 false, so TargetFound is never polled and the glow stays off) does not. The five gap options below turn that race into a guaranteed-delivered state. Corrections to the digest confirmed this pass: (1) ForceSendZDO is distance-independent but revision-gated — AddForceSendZdos drops any id for which peer.ShouldSend is false (:77273) and ShouldSend is purely a revision compare (:76003-76014); a 'touch to resync' needs a real DataRevision bump. (2) TeleportWorld.Teleport uses the SOURCE portal's compiled m_exitDistance (this.m_exitDistance :143545), not the destination's. (3) RandEventSystem.GetBossEvent is EnemyHud.instance.GetActiveBoss().m_bossEvent (:106939-106949) — per-client HUD state; only the activeBosses global key half of the NoBossPortals gate is world-wide. (4) ZNetView.Awake corrects Type/Distant only when the client owns the ZDO (:82583-82590) and never touches Persistent on the existing-ZDO path; a server-set Type on a real portal is reverted the moment ReleaseNearbyZDOS hands it to a nearby player, but sticks on a prefab-less anchor no ZNetView ever adopts. (5) ZDO.m_prefab defaults to -1 (:73317) but ZDO.Initialize sets Valid=true which writes 0 (:73468-73478, :73503), so a CreateNewZDO'd anchor with no SetPrefab serializes prefab 0; the client's CreateObject returns null silently for 0 (:81999-82002) and IsPrefabZDOValid excludes it from the IsAreaReady wait (:81986-81994, :82076) — the Void Anchor claim holds. (6) The CLIENT never evicts a received ZDO: the only removal path is HandleDestroyedZDO; ZNetScene.RemoveObjects destroys instances, and DestroyZDO only for non-persistent owned ZDOs (:82196-82227). A destination pushed once is held for the whole session, so a join-time push permanently satisfies TargetFound for static portals. (7) A vanilla client generates zones at its destination one per 0.1 s tick (CreateLocalZones returns after the first PokeLocalZone that spawns :113993-114012; ZoneSystem.Update 0.1 s :113925) in SpawnMode.Client (:114028, never generates vegetation/location ZDOs — it depends on the server having ghost-generated the zone), and CreateObjectsSorted refuses to instantiate anything until IsActiveAreaLoaded() (:82107) — so even a perfectly pre-streamed distant:false teleport has a client-local floor of ~2 s timer + ~1.5-3 s zone spawning; still well under vanilla's 8 s. (8) The server has a per-peer ledger of exactly which ZDOs each peer holds and at which revision: ZDOPeer.m_zdos (:75981), readable through the private ZDOMan.m_peers list (:76041) with the publicizer — the missing 'readiness' primitive for every JIT option. (9) The server's own send loop services ONE peer per Update frame and then waits 0.05 s (:76843-76861); with N peers a full cycle is 0.05 s + N frames, and each SendZDOs call is capped at 10240 bytes minus the socket's pending queue and abandons the cycle if fewer than 2048 bytes are free (:77010-77019). (10) Chat-free RTT is available: Game registers RPC_Ping/RPC_Pong on EVERY peer (:100065-100066), the client's RPC_Ping echoes the float back to the sender (:100877-100880), and a Harmony prefix on the private Game.RPC_Pong(long sender, float time) (:100882) yields per-peer RTT = Time.time - time; ZRpc's own 1 s ping (:83862-83879) is liveness-only. ZSteamSocket.GetConnectionQuality (:86627-86648) exposes Steam's m_nPing but calls the CLIENT-side SteamNetworkingSockets API (:86641) while every other server-build call uses SteamGameServerNetworkingSockets (:86595) — expect 0 on a dedicated server; needs an in-game check. Flagged-claim positions: EnvMan/GetDayFraction headless, ZSyncTransform.m_characterParentSync, PrivateArea.m_radius and portal-prefab WearNTear support settings remain Inspector/in-game unknowns and are out of scope for these five gaps; the WearNTear caveat (unsupported phantom portals demolished by m_noSupportWear on the owning client :149662-149711) is real for Phantom Anchor Fabrication and is why every option below prefers prefab-0 'void anchors' or existing portals as pushed destinations.

### gapfill:wildcard
Cross-cutting findings from this gap-fill pass, all read directly from the decompile:

1. PersistentEventSystem is the missing server-controlled 'removable marker + radius + weather + gated spawns' channel. Its RPC entry point places events at random world positions (:105341-105379), so portal-anchored use requires direct list injection plus the private UpdateClientEventsList (:105407). Joining peers PULL the list (client m_onNewPeer → RequestActiveEventsList, :105289/:105391-105405), so the server needs no join hook. Critical hazard: ActivePersistentEvent.Source has no bounds check and is evaluated inside every client's Minimap loop (:104938, client :57517). The privatearea brief's census mislabels the four registrations at :105284-105287 as RandEventSystem's; RandEventSystem's only routed RPC is "SetEvent" (:106781). RPC_RequestStartEvent/StopEvent run on the server with no sender check (:105341-105389) — any client can start/stop Bog Witch events; RPC_RequestStopEvent even calls RemoveAt(FindIndex) with no -1 guard (:105385-105386), an ArgumentOutOfRange crash vector.

2. TerrainComp is the only server-writable geometry: blob format :143805-143833, index math :129177-129183/:129263, ±8 m clamp :143969, one compiler per zone enforced client-side :143736-143741. It also gives the server the REAL ground height (generated + deltas), which every arrival-safety option should read instead of the dead collider queries.

3. Structural integrity: WearNTear.UpdateWear (:149662-149829) demolishes unsupported phantoms at m_health per update regardless of stored s_health (:149822-149828); support comes from terrain-layer or static-collider contact within ~0.15 m (:150041-150057, bounds +0.3 :149644-149647). Levers: exact placement, LoadFields WearNTear.m_noSupportWear=false, GlobalKeys.NoBuildingFall (:149825), Landing Pad. ApplyDamage/RPC_Damage both no-op when stored health ≤ 0 (:150334, :150389-150393) — a curiosity, not a design.

4. Field-ownership inversion CONFIRMED and corrected: TeleportWorld.Teleport uses this.m_allowAllItems (:143533) and this.m_exitDistance (:143546) — the SOURCE portal. LoadFields is a supported vanilla data contract (spawn command writes the same keys, client :44423-44430). Piece.m_canBeRemoved (:136171) is a further LoadFields-reachable public bool that makes the vanilla hammer refuse removal (:12375).

5. Ships: Forward/Backward/Stop/Rudder are ungated ZNetView RPCs (:140482-140485, :140538-140593) but the owner's physics forces Stop when m_players.Count == 0 (:140606-140610) and drops Slow/Back without a helmsman (:140611-140614) — 'unattended ferry' is dead; 'crewed ferry under sail' is live. Rider attach correction limit is 4 m per tick (:2118-2135); non-owner lerp 20 %/snap 5 m (:87714-87718). Portal ARRIVAL onto a deck remains impossible (:15343-15349, :113424).

6. Non-portal ZDO relocation is clean (SetSector re-files + ZDOSectorInvalidated, :73752-73768, :75989-75996) and the client re-follows tames by name (:19472-19486) — the 'move the portal' ruling does not apply to companions.

7. LocationIcons is per-peer and wholesale-replace (:113581-113607); the client's default respawn falls through to the first "StartTemple" entry (client :100796-100800, :115437-115445). Gaps 6 and 11 are one mechanism and are specified once above.

8. Sector Zero: the decisive predicate is ZoneSystem.IsActiveAreaLoaded() at zone (15625,15625), fed by CreateLocalZones → PokeLocalZone → SpawnZone(Full) → HeightmapBuilder.IsTerrainReady (:113930, :114071-114092, :114054-114069); if true, the server-only reaper (:82137-82143) destroys prefab-less ZDOs in sector 0. Needs one probe.

9. Admin channel: Terminal.TryRunCommand forwards RemoteCommand-flagged commands that fail IsValid (client :45741-45744) → ZNet.RPC_RemoteCommand admin-gated (:81879-81888) → headless Console (:100038-100041). The ops catalog's 'ruled-out' is wrong; the channel is admin-only and alive.

10. Boss blackout: GetBossEvent is a per-client EnemyHud lookup (:106939-106949); only activeBosses is world-wide. Any blanket veto of remote SetGlobalKey must whitelist activeBosses and defeated_* (:3153-3165).
